entries.purpose: Define the primary workstation shell, canvas hierarchy, node language, inspector density, command bars, and engineering state treatment.

PAGE AND SEMANTICS: This is the ClearVision Flow editor with a project/version command band, operator category rail, selected-node Inspector, central node canvas, preview/result Inspector, save/readiness/run controls, and bottom status context. Preserve product semantics and functional hierarchy; keep the existing capability regions and selected-node editing relationship, but redesign the visual presentation at a premium professional product level. SPATIAL STRUCTURE: use stable graphite application chrome, a narrow dark tool rail, a light high-contrast canvas, dense left parameter Inspector, restrained right preview/result panel, crisp splitters, and a compact command/status hierarchy. REPRODUCTION ORDER: every panel boundary, toolbar, row, field, port, node, status, and spacing interval must be clearly implementable at 1920x1080; use 3-6 px radii and 1 px borders. VISUAL SYSTEM: mix graphite #171c22/#222932 with cool neutral work surfaces; reserve cinnabar #b6453c for brand/selection, use action blue #166f9f, OK #16866f, NG #d12f3f, warning #9b6a13; system typography and familiar engineering icons. The generated image is a visual design reference, not the source of truth for product copy, workflow names, business data, node labels, or values. PROHIBITIONS: no logo or watermark contamination, no sci-fi HUD, no neon, no glassmorphism, no decorative gradient, no poster headline, no giant cards or pills, no invented capability, no fake authoritative telemetry, no collage, and no visually spectacular but impractical layout.
